::: {.status-banner}
**This is a working draft.** Several claims below are still being verified against
primary sources, and a few points are actively disputed across the sources gathered
so far. Anywhere you see a caveat callout, treat the claim as a documented lead, not
a settled fact. See [Sources & Open Questions](sources.qmd) for the full list.
:::

UCLA's data archive runs from one political scientist's personal collection in
1961 to a campus-wide research data service today. This site documents that
lineage on its own terms, independent of any grant proposal, advocacy document,
or administrative reorganization that happens to reference parts of it.

## The lineage, at a glance

| Year | What happened | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| 1961 | Political scientist Dwaine Marvick founds the Political Behavior Archive | [Origins](origins.qmd) |
| 1962 | UCLA becomes a founding member institution of ICPSR | [Origins](origins.qmd) |
| 1964 | The archive merges into UCLA's Survey Research Center | [Origins](origins.qmd) |
| 1976–77 | The archive becomes a service unit of the Institute for Social Science Research (ISSR) | [The ISSR Era](issr-era.qmd) |
| ~2009–10 | ISSR is renamed the Institute for Social Research (ISR) | [The ISSR Era](issr-era.qmd) |
| ~2011 | ISR disappears from UCLA's catalog; the archive continues as a standalone unit | [The ISSR Era](issr-era.qmd) |
| 2014 | The Social Science Data Archive joins the UCLA Library (MOU executed August 2015) | [Library & DSC](library-dsc.qmd) |
| 2018 | The unit is renamed the Data Science Center (DSC) | [Library & DSC](library-dsc.qmd) |

This history stops at the DSC's structure as it stood before 2026. See
[Library & DSC](library-dsc.qmd) for why.
